name: Retro Record Store Y2K Flash Portrait

project_info.title: Retro Record Store Y2K Flash Portrait

main_subject.description: An adult Asian woman with long softly waved brown hair, natural dewy makeup, and a warm, gently shy smile, seated at a dark wooden table in a vintage record-store lounge.
main_subject.wardrobe: A red-and-white gingham puff-sleeve blouse with a high neckline, paired with high-waisted matching wide-leg trousers; festive nail art without logos or text.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Relaxed seated three-quarter pose, one hand lightly near a record sleeve and eyes turned toward camera.

composition_elements.setting: A cozy dark-wood music lounge with neatly arranged blank-spined records and CDs, a softly glowing Christmas tree, and restrained festive decorations.
composition_elements.foreground_props: An unbranded vintage amplifier, a plain-label record player, a transparent iced matcha glass with no branding, a generic compact red camera, and small unlabeled holiday desserts.
composition_elements.framing: Medium portrait from table height, subject centered slightly right, with the wood tabletop and music-room texture establishing the scene.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: All record sleeves, CD spines, equipment, camera surfaces, packaging, and décor are blank or abstract with no readable text, logos, or recognizable brands.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Warm tungsten room light balanced with a subtle direct on-camera flash for a candid early-2000s snapshot feel.
lighting_and_atmosphere.mood: Friendly, nostalgic, festive, and authentically lived-in.

technical_specs.rendering: Fine film grain, gentle highlight bloom, natural skin texture, realistic hands, clean facial anatomy, and restrained color fade.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical, hyper-realistic 35mm point-and-shoot still photograph of an adult Asian woman with long softly waved brown hair, natural dewy makeup, and a warm shy smile, seated at a dark wooden table in a vintage record-store lounge. She wears a red-and-white gingham puff-sleeve high-neck blouse with matching high-waisted wide-leg trousers. Pose her in a relaxed three-quarter seated position, one hand lightly near a record sleeve and eyes toward the camera. Surround her with blank-spined records and CDs, a softly glowing Christmas tree, restrained holiday décor, an unbranded vintage amplifier, plain-label record player, transparent unbranded iced matcha glass, generic compact red camera, and unlabeled holiday desserts. Use warm tungsten ambient light plus a subtle direct on-camera flash, medium table-height framing, fine grain, slight highlight bloom, natural skin texture, accurate hands and face, and a cozy festive Y2K mood. Keep every surface free of readable text, logos, and recognizable brands.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, childlike styling, celebrity likeness, named person, doll-like anatomy, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, lingerie, fetish styling, smoking, cigarette, alcohol branding, logos, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, warped face, plastic skin, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Identity references are optional and may only depict a consenting adult; preserve only general approved facial and hair traits. Use wardrobe, environment, and prop references as replaceable visual guides rather than copying brands or text.

assets.usage: Match general adult facial structure, long brown hair, and natural makeup only.

assets.usage: Guide the red-and-white gingham blouse and covered high-waisted trousers; remove any labels.

policy_review.notes: Clarified an adult subject, replaced revealing outfit language with covered clothing, removed brand and readable-text dependencies, and prohibited celebrity likeness, smoking, and sexualized presentation.
